ache.title: Kept going back? That’s the design working
ache.note: The title says it all: he kept going back to Star Rail. That pull back isn’t a lack of willpower. It’s what dailies, events and new banners are built to do. Noticing it, the way this title does without meaning to, is the first step out.
watch: the urge to return after a break
new banners timed to bring you back
ache.tip: If you keep going back to something you meant to leave, tell someone you trust. It helps more than you’d think.
lines: “kept going back.” he said it, not me
returning isn’t weakness. it’s the hook
...he did stop going back, in the end. proud
